note: Corrections to the input: lab was 'unknown'; it is Zhejiang University (College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering; lead researcher Yang Yihao, dean Chen Hongsheng). Kind was 'harness'; sources describe an autonomous research agent and do not use the word harness. The only dated event is the unveiling: China Daily (2026-07-21) says Zhejiang University 'unveiled an AI scientific discovery system on July 15' (2026). An unveiling is an announcement, not a release, so it is not recorded in 'release'. The same article says the system is expanding 'from internal research validation to broader real-world scientific applications' and is 'expected to' integrate more tools; it reports no public availability, waitlist, API, pricing or open-source license. The release_basis 'none_exists' rests on that internal-validation wording and on finding no public-launch report, which is a judgment, not a confirmed fact. Revisit if a public launch turns up. The SCMP article (scmp.com/news/china/science/article/3361370) returned HTTP 403 on fetch, so only its search snippets were seen. The China Daily quotes come from a WebFetch summary of the page, not the raw page text. Not opened: the Zhejiang University announcement and the arXiv paper 2609.08196 (AstaBench evaluation).
